messages:
ada: Quick note 1: we're starting orchestration for the cloud publisher listings (AWS / GCP / Azure). Need clear owners for: AMI/container builds, SKU mapping + trial mapping, legal attestations, branding assets, and regional localization. Suggest we split by artifact type rather than by cloud.

rafael: I can take AMI + container packaging for Linux images. Will standardize naming: `redwood-inf-<cloud>-<region>-v1` and include cloud-init. Also will add a small smoke test script.

nina: I'll own SKU mapping and pricing bundles. Question: do we want unified meter semantics (tokens) across clouds? Some portals force separate OfferIDs per cloud.

ad a: typo: "ada". (Note: ensure trial credit behavior.)

ada: nina 1, keep token metering as canonical, but map OfferIDs per cloud like you said. We'll surface both token-metered and a flat reserved bundle in the listing.

legal-bot: Legal checklist generated: canonical EULA (v2.1), privacy snippet, support contact, export control attestation, KMS and data residency statement. Please attach signed EULA to PR: https://git.redwood/legal/pulls.

rafael: putting AMI artifacts in the shared staging bucket: s3://redwood-marketplace/staging/1716147777/ with a manifest `images.json`. Will also publish container image tags to gcr and ecr.

nina: I'll prepare SKU spreadsheet and mapping to OfferIDs. Plan: one sheet per cloud, a mapping column to our internal product codes, and a trialSKU column. Posting in 2 hours.

marketplace-bot: Publisher portal invite accepted by ada. Portal link: https://publisher.example.com/orgs/redwood/inbox. Reminder: Azure requires a distinct trial SKU and an offer-level pricing file (CSV).

ada: Good catch. Rafael 1, can you ensure AMI manifests include a `publisher_metadata` JSON blob with support contact and KMS hints?

rafael: Yep. Will add fields: `support_email`, `kms_compatible: true`, `recommended_instance_types`.

nina: Pricing note 1: for reserved bundles we need to specify units (vCPU hours) on the Azure and AWS listing; GCP accepts a flat price but we can indicate token equivalence. Will flag specifics in the sheet.

legal-bot: Localization plan: EULA baseline + EN/FR/DE/ES translations for EU launch. Legal will draft an addendum for region-specific data residency claims.

ada: Timeline proposal: assets + AMIs by Thu EOD, SKU sheet + pricing by Wed noon, legal docs by Wed EOD, publisher portal upload and smoke validation on Friday. Anyone sees an issue?

rafael: OK on AMI timeline. Need access to the staging subnet for final test builds. Please add me to infra-project.

nina: Pricing by Wed noon is doable, will include trial length options (14d, 30d) and recommended defaults.

marketplace-bot: Action created: MP-4890 "Marketplace asset orchestration: staging upload + portal validation" assigned to rafael,nina due 2026-03-27.

ada: Great. Link to central assets folder: https://drive.redwood/marketplace/1716147777-orchestration. Drop all logos (svg/png), 2x screenshots, short blurbs (60 words), and FAQ entry for billing.

rafael: I'll upload images + smoke logs to the folder after each build.

nina: Adding pricing FAQ and trial behavior note. Also will include mapping to analytics tags for cost tracking.

legal-bot: PR started: https://git.redwood/legal/pull/256. Tagging @legal-team for translation budget approval.

ada: If anyone hits portal validation quirks, ping me immediately and I'll open a support case with the marketplace. Thanks team :tada:
